model_policy: inherit actual current model/effort; record observed settings, no override requested

human_contribution: Neutral request for five unusually imaginative essays; no human thesis/argument supplied

concurrency: Unique campaign directory, helper, agent names, run IDs; shared append-only archive via locking; no shared instructions/config/services edits; defer shared refresh
